## What's new

- **Native text menus.** Right-click text or a field in Desktop windows for the usual copy, paste, undo and selection actions, plus Copy Link Address for links.
- **Fewer false firewall warnings.** Legitimate CLI help, agent documentation and mixed shell output are better distinguished from instructions trying to redirect an agent. This reduces false positives without exempting help or documentation from screening.
- **Local BigBrain vaults for self-hosted Ficus.** Operators can explicitly connect an approved BigBrain vault on the same Core host. This is self-hosted, same-host support only—not a hosted service, remote-vault bridge or access to vaults on another device.
- **No automatic transcript exports.** Automatic transcript capture and its background delivery have been removed, with no automatic summary replacement. Ordinary conversation history and manual downloads remain available.
- **Limited evaluation access.** Operators can separately authorize workers to evaluate decision models without handing them provider keys or access to provider settings. Evaluation access is not granted automatically.
- **More accurate Anthropic recovery signals.** A successful credential probe no longer clears unrelated credit, rate-limit, network or generation failures. Persisted-state and alert-churn regressions are covered; the original restart-specific production trigger was not reproduced.
- **Smaller fixes.** Recovery checks keep account boundaries and retry deadlines intact, while successful generation can still clear a failure normally.

**Upgrade note:** This is a forward-only database change that removes the retired automatic-export schema. Use the supported bundled Desktop update so the API and worker move together; do not leave an old exporter worker running. Older exporter builds are not rollback-compatible with the migrated database.
